meta.name: options
meta.description: Compare feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommend a path with costs, constraints and evidence. Use for an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把几条可行方案逐条比清代价与限制,给出一条有依据的推荐路线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正为一个技术或交付难题在几条路之间纠结,想算清代价再拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Compare feasible paths for a problem, pick one with clear costs and trade-offs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're weighing several ways to solve a problem and need costs and trade-offs spelled out.

howto.what: 它会先读取任务上下文契约和方法文档,再对比客户问题的可行方案,产出一条带成本、约束和证据的推荐路径。它只做架构或交付决策,不写实现。
howto.when: 当你需要做架构或交付决策而非实现时进入。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前已脱敏的数据包与范围,不重跑初始化或已答问题。

say.text: 对比这几个方案,推荐一条路径,并列出成本和约束
say.note: 输出推荐路径及成本、约束、证据

say.text: 这是客户的背景,帮我做交付方式的选择
say.note: 基于给定上下文比较可行方案

say.text: 不确定的地方保留为未知,别当成已实现
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: It reads the task-context contract and method, compares feasible approaches to a customer problem, and recommends a path with costs, constraints and evidence. It covers architecture or delivery decisions, not implementation.
howto.when_en: Use it when you face an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or re-asking.

say_en.text: Compare these approaches, recommend one path, and list costs and constraints
say_en.note: Returns a recommendation with costs and constraints

say_en.text: Here is the customer context — help me choose a delivery approach
say_en.note: Compares feasible approaches from the given context

say_en.text: Keep unknowns as unknown; don't treat them as implemented
say_en.note: Separates implementation from verification and acceptance
